label: WhatsApp Receive (Baileys)
description: Fires an execution when a WhatsApp message arrives at the project's WhatsApp bridge. Wire this node's `endpointUrl` input from a BaileyBridge node; the listener subscribes to the bridge's SSE events stream and fires on every `message.received` event that passes the filter settings.

inputs.name: endpointUrl
inputs.description: Output of a BaileyBridge node. The listener subscribes to <endpointUrl without /action>/events.

inputs.name: ignoreGroups
inputs.label: Ignore group chats
inputs.description: Only fire on direct messages. A message posted in a group chat is dropped as it arrives and never starts a run.

inputs.name: messageTypes
inputs.label: Only these message types
inputs.description: Only fire on messages of these types: text, image, video, audio, document, sticker, contact, location, unknown. Leave empty to fire on every type except unknown. A message of an unlisted type is dropped as it arrives and never starts a run. unknown is anything else WhatsApp sends (a reaction, a poll, a protocol message): it has no content, and fires only when you list it.

outputs.name: content
outputs.description: The message's text, or the caption of a picture, video or document. Absent for a voice note, for a picture, video or document sent without a caption, and for a sticker, contact, location or unknown message. FirstInOrder over a voice note's transcript and content picks whichever exists.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: Stored-file reference for image/video/audio/document/sticker messages; absent for text.

outputs.name: fileSize
outputs.description: The media's size in bytes, as WhatsApp reports it before anything is downloaded; absent for text. Gate on it to refuse a file too large to process.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: The length of a voice note or a video, in seconds; absent for anything else. Gate on it to refuse an hour-long voice note before paying to transcribe it.
